sections.title: Worth the *drive*
body: Jamrock Caribana sits on Highway 421, the old road between Aiken and Augusta, in Warrenville.
The kitchen cooks Deep South Jamaican food, and caters to vegetarians, vegans and anyone trying Jamaican food for the first time.
list: New to Jamaican food? Ask us

items.q: Do you have vegetarian or vegan food?
items.a: Yes. The kitchen caters to vegetarians and vegans. Call and ask what's on today.
Yes. Jamrock Caribana offers takeout and delivery as well as dining in.

items.q: I've never had Jamaican food. Where do I start?
items.a: Customer favorites include jerk chicken, oxtail, and rice & peas with cabbage.

before: No website of its own: a search leads to delivery apps, review sites and directory listings
Hours, prices and the menu differ from one of those sites to the next
The first thing a new customer sees is not something the restaurant controls
after: A site the restaurant owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room to add the full menu, photos and specials as the owner supplies them
